description: Current catalog list price per unit for this SKU. Use it only for price bands or current catalog value - it is NOT the price the customer paid. Historical revenue must come from Order_Items.unit_price.

alias: 成交单价,下单单价,售价,单价
description: Price per unit actually charged on this order line at order time. This is the revenue truth for history; Products.unit_price is only the current list price. line_amount is quantity multiplied by this value.

alias: 父订单号,所属订单,订单号
description: Foreign key to Orders.order_id - the order this line belongs to. Join here to reach order-level attributes such as order_status, order_channel and date_order_placed.

alias: 发货订单号,所属订单,订单号
description: Foreign key to Orders.order_id identifying which order this dispatch fulfils. One order can produce several shipments, so joining inflates row counts - aggregate Orders before counting orders.
